targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, provider) region, tenant_scope, provider, health_status FROM health_evaluation_run WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, provider, evaluated_at DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest WHERE health_status = 'DEGRADED';

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, provider) region, tenant_scope, provider, health_status FROM health_evaluation_run WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, provider, evaluated_at DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest WHERE health_status = 'UNHEALTHY';

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, provider) region, tenant_scope, provider, health_status FROM health_evaluation_run WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, provider, evaluated_at DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest WHERE health_status = 'NO_DATA';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM alert WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND severity = 'CRITICAL' AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider';

SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, provider) region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, provider, health_status, evaluated_at, data_as_of, rule_count, transition_count, reasons FROM health_evaluation_run WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, provider, evaluated_at DESC;

SELECT region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, provider, freshness_status, freshness_lag_seconds, freshness_sla_seconds, consecutive_failures, data_as_of, last_run_at, last_error_code, last_error_message FROM health_runner_status WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY CASE freshness_status WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 1 WHEN 'NO_DATA' THEN 2 WHEN 'STALE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, freshness_lag_seconds DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT opened_at, last_seen_at, severity, health_impact, region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, provider, rule_id, reason_code, reason_message, observed_value, comparison, threshold, sample_size, occurrence_count, runbook_ref FROM alert WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, last_seen_at DESC;
